name: List games
description: Postgres builds the response: the one `body` column is json_agg / json_build_object, and since Orion 1.6 a json column decodes as the document itself, so the respond task copies it into data.body and shapes the response. Keeping response construction in SQL is deliberate -- a mistyped operator inside a map mapping is written through as a literal object with a 200, where a mistyped SQL function is a loud error. Before 1.6 the column had to be cast ::text and parsed back by a parse_json task.

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', g.slug, 'name', g.name, 'season', (SELECT json_build_object('number', s.number, 'state', CASE WHEN s.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' WHEN now() < s.submissions_open_at THEN 'scheduled' WHEN now() < s.submissions_close_at THEN 'open' ELSE 'settling' END, 'submissions_open_at', s.submissions_open_at, 'submissions_close_at', s.submissions_close_at, 'closed_at', s.closed_at, 'close_requested_at', s.close_requested_at, 'engine_digest', s.engine_digest, 'rules', s.rules) FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = g.id ORDER BY (s.closed_at IS NULL) DESC, s.number DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY g.name), '[]'::json) AS body FROM games g
